subject: How to recall specific output in sem

messages.author: 98e72a3b4e9c6091
messages.subject: How to recall specific output in sem
parts:
Dear all,
             I am interested only in mean i and mean s value with their respective standard error from below mentioned model. Is there any way to do it in  lavvan?  
               
Model.L<- ' 
          # INTERCEPT AND SLOPE EQUATIONS
          i=~1  * Time1 + 1 * Time2 + 1 * Time3 + 1 * Time4 + 1 * Time5 + 1 * Time6
          s=~0 * Time1 + 1 * Time2 + 2 * Time3 + 3 * Time4 + 4 * Time5 + 5 * Time6
           '
   fit.L<- growth(Model.L, data=CD4, missing="ml")
  
 summary(fit.L,standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE,rsq=TRUE)

Any help is greatly appreciated !

messages.author: d275eff513efeea3
messages.subject: Re: How to recall specific output in sem
parts:
All estimates can be obtained via the parameterestimates() function.

parameterestimates(fit.L)$est[c(28,29)]
parameterestimates(fit.L)$se[c(28,29)]


Leonard
